_comment: Transform control for row 290. capture.sh is a shell entry point rather than an importable Python module, so the control performs its compile-time analogue: bash parses the live script without asserting fixture behavior. Removing the serial assignment remains valid shell and must ESCAPE, proving M1 is caught by the runtime assertion rather than a parse/import failure.
subject: transform control -- parsing capture.sh does not constrain serial fixture routing
